Commentary.Commentary: Pakistani bowlers would be happy to see the English bowlers getting some swing as they would soon come out to bowl. Don't go anywhere as we will be back with the English innings in a jiffy.

Beautiful inswinging delivery by Stuart Broad brought Misbah's long stint in the middle to a halt. Century by Misbah-ul Haq and a half century by Sahfiq took Pakistan to a decent total. Woakes was the spearhead of English bowling, scalping 6 wickets, which are his career best figures in a Test innings.

End of first innings! Swinging deliveries from Broad and Woakes got the better of the Pakistani batsmen in the morning session. Sarfraz played a short aggressive cameo in the morning but failed to capitalise on it as he pushed a short delivery in the hands of Vince at backward point off Woakes' bowling.

OUT! Edged and that's all over for Pakistan! Broad bowls a length delivery on off, Amir looks to poke at it but gets a thick outside edge which flies in the slip cordon where Root at second slip takes it by moving to his left. PAKISTAN ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 339!
Fuller length delivery on middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Amir looks to go over the top but fails to put bat on ball.
Full on leg, defended towards the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Ah, a boundary now! This is frustrating for the bowler! He bowls it full and gets it to shape away, then he bowls a short ball and he's taken for runs. Tad short and outside off, Shah stays put inside the crease and opens the face of the bat to guide it down to third man for a boundary.
Peach of a delivery! This is good stuff from Woakes! Bowls it full on off which swings away nicely. Shah was playing inside the line but gets beaten.
Full length delivery on off, moving away. Shah prods forward to defend but gets beaten up.
Shah was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
On middle and off, Amir defends it off the back foot.

Beautifully played! Fuller length delivery on middle, Yasir steps forward and drives it past the man at mid on. That was played really well. Finn from mid on gives it a chase and keeps them down to three runs.
Short and going down the leg side, Yasir has got nothing to do with that one.
Full and angled on middle, driven towards mid on.
Good length delivery on off, Shah looks to drive this through the off side but gets beaten by the away movement.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
FOUR! Take that Woakes, says amir! Fuller length delivery on off, Amir lunges forward and drills it past the man at mid off for another boundary. 13 from that over, these are valuable runs!

FOUR BYES! Chris bangs it on middle, Amir is happy to duck and evade it. It was too high for poor Bairstow to grab but the keeper leaps as much as he can but fails to collect it. The ball races away for a boundary.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery on off, Amir stands tall inside the crease and crunches it through backward point. That was hit perfectly in the gap.
Length delivery served outside off, Amir looks to slash it through the off side but some extra bounce gets the better of him and he gets beaten.
Driven towards the man at mid off for no runs.
Full and on the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.
Full and around off, Shah pushes it towards covers for a single to get off the mark.
YASIR SHAH is the last man in!

OUT! Knocked him over! That's the end of Misbah's gritty innings. Broad bowls an inswinging yorker which stays a touch low as well. Misbha gets forward to defend but the ball goes through his defense and disturbs the furniture behind. Lord's erupts in joy as England have done a superb job this morning.
Misbah gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.

Broad bowled a nasty bouncer and Amir did well to evade it but in the process he gets hit on his helmet which seems to have been broken. He is asking for a new one. My colleagues here say, Broad beware you'll have to play Amir soon.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Amir ducks to evade it but gets a blow on the helmet. The ball pops towards the leg side and they steal a leg bye.
FOUR! Short of a length delivery on middle, Amir looks to defend but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a boundary.
Good length delivery on off, pushed towards point for a single.
And the man who has been the talking point this summer walks out to bat. MOHAMMAD AMIR! Let's see what he can do!

OUT! Bowled 'em! Another one bites the dust! Woakes, you freaking beauty. This time he pitches it up and gets it to swing in. Riaz had no clue whatsoever as the ball rips in and rattles the stumps. Woakes leaps in the air and then punches it in joy. How many more is he going to take?
Beaten! Full length delivery, shaping away from the batsman. Riaz looks to drive but gets beaten up.
WAHAB RIAZ walks out next!

OUT! In the air... gone! That's a maiden 5-fer for Chris Woakes! What a moment for the young gun, gets a applaud from the crowd. Agreed, scoring a ton at Lord's is special but scalping a 5-wicket haul is no less. Coming to the ball, this was on a length, moved a bit after hitting the deck. Sarfraz gets back to slash it through the off side but ends up spooning it to Vince at backward point who grabs it with glee. End of a aggressive knock from the wicketkeeper.
On a length and some movement again. Ahmed steps out of his crease and defends it down.
Tad full and around off, defended off the front foot towards covers.

Chris Woakes had his best bowling figures in an innings yesterday and would look to take a fifer whereas Misbah would try to get a double century. So will see you all in a while when players arrive on the ground to begin our second day's proceedings.

Hello and welcome to our coverage for the second day of the first Test between England and Pakistan at Lord's. Misbah's century ensured Pakistan had a good first day. Today they will hope that the likes of Sarfraz and the remaining players support him in the middle to put them on the driving seat. English bowlers would like to get an early breakthrough and then clean up the tailenders.
DAY 2, SESSION 1...

Decent contirbutions by Hafeez at the start,  Younis in the middle and Shafiq's half century were building blocks for a good total. Loss of Shafiq and nightwatchman in the last few overs was a bit disappointment for the Pakistani camp. Highlight of the day was Misbah's 10th century and scored first century in England and that too in his first tour to England. He made a statement by his celebration after scoring it. So that's it from us then. Join us tomorrow at 1530 IST for proceedings of second day.

Woakes by far stood out as England's best bowler making four wickets to his name. Ball had a decent debut day, bowling at good line and length earned him his first ever international wicket. Moeen Ali was driven, cut and swept to all parts of the ground. Broad also bowled decent spells with chances being dropped off his bowling while Finn had an off day.

First day comes to a halt with Pakistan being marginally on top as being the visiting team. Misbah and Shafiq's stand took Pakistan to a commanding position in the first innings. Century from the skipper Misbah-ul Haq made the final session and the day in Pakistan's favour.

DAY 1... Session 3...

Pakistan would hope that Shafiq and next to come Sarfraz give Misbah the much needed support in the middle. England would need Finn to find his rhythm as Moeen Ali was taken to all parts of the ground by Misbah and Younis. Let's see who ends up on the top after the end of the first day. So join us back after the break for last and final session of the day.

Ball and Broad both got the wickets and Woakes still was in his first session's rhythm which was a great point for England to look forward for the next session. Misbah's presence at the crease is the only thing which is giving England something to think about over the tea.

England would be the happier of the two after the middle session to see the backs of Azhar Ali and Younis Khan. Also debutant Jake Ball clinched his maiden international wicket by yorking Azhar Ali leg before wickets. Younis Khan also failed to build up on his start and make a big score when he clipped Broad's delivery straight to Moeen Ali at short mid-wicket.

OUT! BALL'S RIGHT ON THE MONEY! And what a ripper of a delivery. Caught Ali low on the pads and gave him no chance. Fired in on leg, slightly coming in and coming in with pace, Ali tries to get his leg out of the way and flick this away but misses, loses his balance as he does so and is rapped hard low on his front foot. There are roaring appeals for an LBW and Umpire Dharmasena, after contemplating for a good while, raises his finger. Azhar isn't satisfied with the decision and hence decides to take a review against it. Replays show that the ball was just clipping the leg stump and it's the umpire's call, so the decision stays. Ball gets his first Test wicket on debut. He'll be ecstatic with that.

Now the experienced Pakistan middle order batsmen Ali and Younis are looking to build a good partnership. They have spent good amount of time in the middle to understand the conditions and use their experience to get a good score. England would look to come back harder in the next session and capture some quick wickets. Join us back after lunch for the next session to get underway.

Hafeez who looked good early on, playing some handsome drives was brought to a halt by a top edge off Woakes bowling. The English bowlers had a decent session with Woakes impressing the most by taking both of the Pakistani wickets. Debutant Ball also had a decent bowling session. Also a dropped chance of Hafeez early on off Broad's bowling by Vince cost them some few runs.

Jake Ball makes his Test debut at Lord's, replacing James Anderson who is suffering from a shoulder injury.
Pakistan XI - Mohammad Hafeez, Shan Masood, Azhar Ali, Younis Khan, Misbah-ul-Haq(c), Asad Shafiq, Sarfraz Ahmed(w), Wahab Riaz, Mohammad Amir, Yasir Shah, Rahat Ali.
England XI - Alastair Cook(c), Alex Hales, Joe Root, James Vince, Gary Ballance, Jonny Bairstow(w), Moeen Ali, Chris Woakes, Stuart Broad, Steven Finn, Jake Ball.
PAKISTAN WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT!

However, Pakistan will face stiff competition from England as the hosts are in fine form following their clinical demolition of their Sri Lankan visitors. The absence of an injured James Anderson from the first Test will surely be a blow but this allows debutant Jake Ball his chance to shine. Stay tuned for the toss and the live coverage of the match!

Hello and welcome to the 1st Test between England and Pakistan at The Lord's cricket ground. This is the first match of Pakistan's tour of England and will set the tone for the rest of the series. This is a valuable tour for Pakistan as they return to international Test cricket after a long hiatus. They have shown that they are able to cope well with the home side's conditions as they played well in their warm-up matches against Somerset and Sussex.
